sections.kicker: Prepared for Tripsguru by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Tripsguru has a name with an idea in it. The site speaks like every luxury agency.
sections.keep: Your bio line, "TRAVEL LIKE A GURU." It turns the name into a reason.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.

pins.quote: Luxury journeys, Meticulously planned, Seamlessly delivered
pins.what: The site headline is the line every luxury agency writes.
pins.why: This is the thing that feels off: nothing in it says Tripsguru or Kenya.
pins.how: Write the headline from the guru idea, not from luxury adjectives.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: Travellers compare you on price with every agency using the same words.

pins.what: Your best line lives only on Instagram.
pins.why: It is the one sentence that only Tripsguru can say.
pins.how: Make it the core of the site and every itinerary page.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: The name keeps working without its meaning.

pins.what: The bio sells four businesses in one line.
pins.why: Safaris next to MICE makes a luxury agency read as a general travel desk.
pins.how: Lead with the one you want to be known for and keep the rest as services.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: Luxury clients see a booking office, not a curator.

sections.intro: You said something feels off, even after a new website. I think it is the voice, not the site.
